scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @helpdesk/api" "npm run dev -w @helpdesk/web"

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @helpdesk/api && npm run typecheck -w @helpdesk/web
